name: Cari Fais
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed September 3, 2025 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 0.
record_status_note: No qualifying decision identified. One public Strike 3 expedited-discovery opinion was found, but it is a routine application used in more than 1,000 similar cases and did not clear the significance gate. The appointment preceded the cutoff by about one year.

biography.text: Fais graduated summa cum laude from George Washington University (2002) and earned her J.D. from Columbia Law School (2008), where she was a notes editor of the Columbia Law Review. She practiced at Debevoise & Plimpton and Friedman Kaplan, clerked for Third Circuit Judge Michael A. Chagares, served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey—including leading an opioid unit—and directed the New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs.
